newsitem.title: USA: Funco backs Q2, FY98 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: Funco backs Q2, FY98 EPS view.

text.p: Funco Inc, which sells new and used video games, said Friday it backed the First Call mean earnings estimates for the second quarter of $0.07 a share and for fiscal 1998 of $1.22 a share.
"I think we're real comfortable with $0.07 in the second quarter," David Pomije, chairman, told Reuters after the company's annual meeting here.
"We're very comfortable with that number," he added, referring to $1.22 a share for fiscal 1998 ending in March.
In the second quarter of fiscal 1997, Funco earned $0.01 a share. In fiscal 1997 it earned $0.86 a share.
Pomije said 1998 results will depend upon the U.S. video game industry having access to product from Japan, as well as Funco receiving the share of product that it wants.
"But if you look at history, we've beaten expectations in the last three quarter," he added.
Funco chief operating officer Stanley Bodine said Funco plans to add 57 stores in fiscal 1998, bringing its total to 245.

"We're committing to having 245 stores open by the end of this fiscal year," Bodine said. "The majority of our store openings will be in the second and third quarter, with some, possibly, going into the fourth quarter. About half of those new stores will come as an expansion of existing markets, and half will be in new markets."
The company had 188 stores at the end of fiscal 1997 and currently has 200 stores.
Pomije said that the company would not be opening any stores in southern California in the near-term. It currently has no presence in that market.
Longer term, Pomije said he expected the company to have 300 stores open by the 1998 Christmas holiday.
